msg.matex.gallath.gift.like.2: Achas que um enfeite compra meu favor? …Tudo bem, continua.
msg.matex.gallath.gift.like.3: Mortais geralmente oferecem coisas piores. Vou permitir.

msg.matex.gallath.gift.love.2: Tch — sabe mesmo como desarmar uma demônia caída.

msg.matex.sarah.gift.like.1: Sementes de cacau? Onde você achou isso?
msg.matex.sarah.gift.like.2: Ah, obrigada — eu queria adicionar isso à coleção.
msg.matex.sarah.gift.love.2: Hmm, continue assim e talvez ganhe algo.
msg.matex.sarah.gift.love.3: Não pense que eu não vi você sorrindo ao trazer isso.

msg.matex.zoey.gift.love.2: Outro? Você sabe mesmo como tratar uma garota~
msg.matex.zoey.gift.love.3: Você está deixando a Zoey toda quentinha por dentro...

msg.matex.jenny.gift.like.2: Um allium? Que fofo da sua parte…!
msg.matex.jenny.gift.love.1: Ah, outro? Bom… o verdadeiro presente aqui é você~.
msg.matex.jenny.gift.love.2: Amor, você é tão gentil. E tão gostoso~.
msg.matex.jenny.gift.love.3: Para de me dar presentes e me pega logo~!
msg.matex.ellie.gift.like.1: Espera… isso é… uma Rosa do Wither de verdade…!
msg.matex.ellie.gift.like.2: Você é meio sem graça, mas isso foi… obrigada…!
msg.matex.ellie.gift.like.3: Incrível… então é assim que é uma Rosa do Wither…!
msg.matex.ellie.gift.love.1: Hmm… você até que é bem gostoso, sabia…
msg.matex.ellie.gift.love.2: Tá precisando de uma mamãe ou algo assim?
msg.matex.ellie.gift.love.3: C-Cala a boca… isso é demais…
msg.matex.bia.gift.like.2: Uau, uau! Um presente pra mim!
msg.matex.bia.gift.like.3: Bia ama presentes! Dá mais pra Bia!
msg.matex.bia.gift.love.1: Eba!! Outro presente! Você devia ser meu dono!
msg.matex.bia.gift.love.2: Eba, eba, eba! Vamos brincar agora!
msg.matex.bia.gift.love.3: A-A Bia ficou no cio por sua causa…
msg.matex.coppie.gift.like.2: Este golem aceitará o presente adequadamente.
msg.matex.coppie.gift.like.3: Por que está dando presentes a este golem, mestre?
msg.matex.coppie.gift.love.1: Este golem… não… eu aprecio isso, mestre.
msg.matex.coppie.gift.love.2: Isso realmente significa muito para mim, mestre.
msg.matex.coppie.gift.love.3: Tem certeza que não quer usar minhas funções sexuais, mestre?

attribute.matex.trait.swift.desc: Quick on her feet, wherever she is going.
attribute.matex.trait.tireless.desc: Burns much less food for the same work.
attribute.matex.trait.clumsy.desc: Every timed action takes her longer.
attribute.matex.signature.flight.desc: She flies. She travels straight to where she is going, over anything in the way.
attribute.matex.signature.sleepless.desc: She never sleeps, and keeps taking base work through the night.
attribute.matex.signature.regenerator.de: Regains half a heart every 3 seconds on her own, hungry or not.
screen.matex.heart_core.job_tip.helper: Does not take a job of her own. Fetches what the working girls need, carries away what they dig up, restocks furnaces, and sorts the chests.
attribute.matex.trait.nimble.desc: A little quicker on her feet.
attribute.matex.trait.runner.desc: Never walks when she can run - and it makes her hungry.
attribute.matex.trait.artisan.desc: Whatever the task, her hands know the quick way.
attribute.matex.trait.workaholic.desc: Works a little faster and asks a little less for it.
attribute.matex.trait.lucky.desc: Things simply go her way, at the bench and in a fight.
attribute.matex.trait.slacker.desc: Slow at everything, but she barely eats while doing it.
attribute.matex.trait.hearty.desc: Gets more out of every meal.
attribute.matex.trait.bottomless_stomach: Eats half again as much as anyone else.
attribute.matex.trait.picky_eater.desc: Gets less out of every meal.
attribute.matex.trait.burly_body.desc: Shrugs off blows, moves a little slower for it.
attribute.matex.trait.hard_skin.desc: Takes a little less from every hit.
attribute.matex.trait.sturdy.desc: Takes less from every hit and is hard to shove.
attribute.matex.trait.magma_armor.desc: Fire and lava do not hurt her.
attribute.matex.trait.frail.desc: Fewer hearts, and every hit lands harder.
attribute.matex.trait.coward.desc: Flinches; every hit lands a little harder.
attribute.matex.trait.musclehead.desc: Hits hardest of all - and is hopeless at the bench.
attribute.matex.trait.hustle.desc: Hits harder and burns food for it.
attribute.matex.trait.guts.desc: Hits harder and has a heart to spare.
attribute.matex.trait.hooligan.desc: Hits harder, works a little slower.
attribute.matex.trait.studious.desc: Learns faster from everything she does.
attribute.matex.trait.legend.desc: A little better at everything that matters. The rarest of all.
attribute.matex.trait.soul_speed.desc: Soul sand, honey and cobwebs barely slow her.
attribute.matex.trait.high_step.desc: Steps up a full block without jumping.
attribute.matex.trait.soaring.desc: Flies faster - only a girl who flies will notice.
attribute.matex.trait.truant.desc: Very slow, and very cheap to keep.
attribute.matex.trait.porter.desc: Hurries when the pack is heavy, and sets out for half a load.
attribute.matex.trait.forager.desc: Spots dropped things from farther off, and hurries them home.
attribute.matex.trait.handy.desc: Quick on her feet with a load, and quick to go and fetch one.
attribute.matex.trait.camel.desc: Goes half a day on a mouthful, and is slower for it.
attribute.matex.trait.fast_metabolism.de: Every meal goes further, and is needed sooner.
attribute.matex.trait.iron_stomach.desc: The Hunger effect cannot touch her.
attribute.matex.trait.thick_hide.desc: Four points of armour, worn under the skin.
attribute.matex.trait.tempered.desc: Heavy blows lose more of their edge.
attribute.matex.trait.soft_landing.desc: A longer drop before it hurts.
attribute.matex.trait.damp.desc: Fire hurts less and goes out sooner.
attribute.matex.trait.magic_guard.desc: Potions and evoker fangs hurt half as much.
attribute.matex.trait.thorns.desc: A third of what hits her hits back.
attribute.matex.trait.glass_cannon.desc: Hits hard and is hit hard.
attribute.matex.trait.sniper.desc: One hit in six lands half again as hard.
attribute.matex.trait.super_luck.desc: One hit in three lands half again as hard.
attribute.matex.trait.vampiric.desc: A fifth of what she deals comes back as health.
attribute.matex.trait.keen_eye.desc: Blindness and darkness cannot touch her.
attribute.matex.trait.scholar.desc: Learns much faster, would rather not fight.
attribute.matex.trait.early_bird.desc: To bed and up again an hour and a half early.
attribute.matex.effect.safe_fall: Falls %s blocks further before it hurts
attribute.matex.effect.sleep_early: Turns in and rises %s hours early
attribute.matex.effect.sleep_late: Turns in and rises %s hours late
attribute.matex.signature.forgeheart.des: Tools in her hands never wear out.
attribute.matex.signature.ore_sense.desc: Every strike at an ore node yields double.
attribute.matex.signature.timber.desc: Every log she fells drops one more.
attribute.matex.signature.nurturer.desc: Baby animals near her grow up five times as fast.
A sold-out villager still finds one more deal for her.
attribute.matex.signature.verdant.desc: Crops within four blocks of her grow while she works.
attribute.matex.signature.sentinel.desc: Hostiles that go for her owner turn on her instead.
attribute.matex.signature.amphibious.des: Water is hers: she never drowns, swims at half again her running pace, and whatever hits her there does half.
attribute.matex.signature.dark_dweller.d: In the dark she takes half damage and moves a quarter faster.
attribute.matex.signature.phoenix.desc: Once a day, a killing blow leaves her at full health where she stands, in a burst of flame.
attribute.matex.signature.blink.desc: Following her owner and left twelve blocks behind, she is simply beside him again.
attribute.matex.signature.juggernaut.des: Nothing moves her and nothing sticks: immune to knockback and to every harmful effect.
attribute.matex.signature.huntress.desc: Her first blow on any creature lands double.
attribute.matex.signature.gourmet.desc: Every meal heals her twice as much.
attribute.matex.signature.thunderborn.de: Lightning cannot hurt her, and one hit in six calls a bolt down on what she struck.
attribute.matex.signature.dominion.desc: Hostiles within ten blocks are weakened and slowed just by her being there.
attribute.matex.signature.shadowstep.des: At night, hostiles lose sight of her unless she has struck within the last five seconds.
attribute.matex.signature.spiderclimb.de: She climbs walls the way a spider does.
attribute.matex.signature.strider.desc: She walks on lava, and fire cannot touch her.
attribute.matex.signature.frost_walker.d: Still water under her feet freezes as she passes, and thaws behind her.
attribute.matex.signature.magnet.desc: Dropped items within six blocks drift to her.
attribute.matex.signature.everfull.desc: Her stomach never drops below six: she is never too hungry to work.
attribute.matex.signature.hibernator.des: She wakes fully fed: her sleep is a meal.
attribute.matex.signature.last_stand.des: Below a quarter health she cannot be hurt for five seconds, once a minute.
Below a quarter health she goes home at once, once a minute.
attribute.matex.signature.iron_grip.desc: When a blow would send her home, she keeps every item she carries.
attribute.matex.signature.mirror.desc: Every projectile that hits her flies back at whoever fired it, and she feels nothing.
attribute.matex.signature.riposte.desc: Struck in melee, she strikes back in the same instant.
attribute.matex.signature.soul_eater.des: Every kill heals her to full.
attribute.matex.signature.executioner.de: Anything below a fifth of its health dies to her next blow.
attribute.matex.signature.assassin.desc: A blow from behind lands triple.
attribute.matex.signature.duelist.desc: Alone against a single foe she hits half again as hard.
attribute.matex.signature.giant_slayer.d: Anything with more than forty health takes double from her.
attribute.matex.signature.momentum.desc: Each blow on the same foe lands a tenth harder than the last, up to double.
attribute.matex.signature.whirlwind.desc: Her blows spill onto every hostile within three blocks of the one she struck, at half.
Every kill is worth ten experience to her.
attribute.matex.signature.gravity_well.d: Hostiles within six blocks are dragged toward her every second.
attribute.matex.signature.repulsor.desc: Every five seconds, hostiles within four blocks are thrown back.
attribute.matex.signature.hallowed.desc: Undead within eight blocks burn as if under the sun.
attribute.matex.signature.defuser.desc: Creepers within six blocks cannot light their fuse.
attribute.matex.signature.hive_mind.desc: Girls within sixteen blocks work a tenth faster while she is about.
attribute.matex.signature.medic.desc: Girls within six blocks heal half a heart every five seconds. Not herself.
attribute.matex.signature.pacesetter.des: Girls within eight blocks move with Speed I.
attribute.matex.signature.warcry.desc: Every blow she lands gives the girls within eight blocks Strength I for five seconds.
attribute.matex.signature.lucky_charm.de: Her owner within eight blocks has Luck.
attribute.matex.signature.peoples_champi: Her owner within eight blocks is Hero of the Village: villagers deal kindly with him.
attribute.matex.signature.lantern_eyes.d: Her owner within eight blocks sees in the dark at night.
attribute.matex.signature.siren.desc: Her owner in water within eight blocks breathes and swims like a dolphin.
attribute.matex.signature.furnace_soul.d: Her stomach is a furnace: one raw thing in her pack smelts itself every ten seconds.
attribute.matex.signature.appraiser.desc: Every trade she makes pays double emeralds.
attribute.matex.signature.arborist.desc: Saplings within four blocks grow into trees while she is near.
attribute.matex.signature.bloom.desc: Grass breaks into flowers where she walks.
attribute.matex.trait.bouncy.desc: Jumps half again as high. Rare.
attribute.matex.trait.gale.desc: Flies much faster. Rare; only a flier notices.
attribute.matex.trait.sure_step.desc: Slowing blocks do not slow her at all.
attribute.matex.trait.long_breath.desc: Holds her breath a while longer.
attribute.matex.trait.cat_feet.desc: Two blocks more before a fall hurts.
attribute.matex.trait.parkour.desc: Eight blocks more before a fall hurts. Rare.
attribute.matex.trait.hunger_sprint.desc: Quicker when hungry - off to find food.
attribute.matex.trait.well_fed_worker.de: Works faster on a full stomach.
attribute.matex.trait.fair_weather.desc: Works much slower in the rain.
attribute.matex.trait.weak_back.desc: Slows right down when the pack is heavy.
attribute.matex.trait.butterfingers.desc: Misses dropped things that are not right in front of her, and dawdles with a load.
attribute.matex.trait.unhelpful.desc: Slows down when carrying for others.
attribute.matex.trait.master_farmer.desc: Very quick in the fields. Rare.
attribute.matex.trait.master_miner.desc: Very quick down the mine. Rare.
Very quick with the axe. Rare.
attribute.matex.trait.master_smith.desc: Very quick at the anvil. Rare.
attribute.matex.trait.good_appetite.desc: Gets a little more out of every meal.
attribute.matex.trait.cold_blooded.desc: Burns much less food after dark.
attribute.matex.trait.sun_fed.desc: Burns less food under the sun.
attribute.matex.trait.rain_drinker.desc: Burns much less food in the rain.
attribute.matex.trait.sweating.desc: Burns more food under the sun.
attribute.matex.trait.nervous_eater.desc: Burns much more food when hurt.
attribute.matex.trait.hardened.desc: Heavy blows lose a little of their edge.
attribute.matex.trait.steady.desc: A little harder to knock about.
attribute.matex.trait.anchored.desc: Cannot be knocked about at all. Rare.
attribute.matex.trait.bristles.desc: A little of what hits her hits back.
attribute.matex.trait.spines.desc: Half of what hits her hits back. Rare.
attribute.matex.trait.arrow_catcher.desc: Arrows and bolts hurt half as much. Rare.
attribute.matex.trait.tinderbox.desc: Fire hurts half again as much.
attribute.matex.trait.adrenaline.desc: Takes much less damage when hurt.
attribute.matex.trait.sun_shield.desc: Takes less damage under the sun.
attribute.matex.trait.storm_skin.desc: Takes less damage in the rain.
attribute.matex.trait.waterlogged.desc: Takes much more damage in water.
attribute.matex.trait.sunburn.desc: Takes more damage under the sun.
attribute.matex.trait.sun_eyes.desc: The Warden's darkness cannot touch her.
attribute.matex.trait.keen_edge.desc: One hit in twelve lands half again as hard.
attribute.matex.trait.leech.desc: A tenth of what she deals comes back as health.
attribute.matex.trait.bloodthirst.desc: A third of what she deals comes back as health. Rare.
attribute.matex.trait.marker.desc: What she hits glows - nowhere to hide.
attribute.matex.trait.grave_fear.desc: Hits the undead softer - she would rather not touch them.
attribute.matex.trait.well_fed_fury.desc: Hits harder on a full stomach.
attribute.matex.trait.gambler.desc: Crits often and gets hit hard.
attribute.matex.trait.showoff.desc: Hits harder and learns faster, and burns food for it.
attribute.matex.trait.nightingale.desc: Up late, and learns from it.
attribute.matex.trait.lark.desc: Up early, and eats a little less.
attribute.matex.trait.sage.desc: Learns much faster and works a little quicker. Rare.
item.matex.trait_charm.tip: Use on a girl: rerolls a slot with any trait, good or bad
item.matex.trait_charm.tip_tier: Use on a girl: rerolls a slot with a random tier %s trait
item.matex.trait_selector.tip: Use on a girl: choose a tier %s trait for a slot
screen.matex.girl_traits.need_tool: Hold a Trait Charm or Trait Selector to work a slot
screen.matex.girl_traits.pick_none: She already has every tier %s trait
attribute.matex.effect.eager_haul: Sets out to haul at half the usual load
attribute.matex.signature.moon_fox.desc: The Moon Fox divides one into many - one self at the new moon, three at the full. When a fight finds her they step out as fighters, each a whole girl with her traits and fury, and converge after fifteen seconds with half of all they dealt returned to her as health. At peace in her base by day they step out as workers: they join the base for the working day, take whatever the Core deals them, and converge at dusk with their packs handed to her.
attribute.matex.trait.heart_of_thunder.d: The thunder she keeps in her heart: her blows carry it, one in five lands as a bolt, and lightning is hers to command, never to fear.
attribute.matex.trait.dustless_tread.des: The fox's step: nothing that means her harm can keep its eye on her until she strikes, nothing underfoot slows her, and the moon quickens her.
attribute.matex.trait.illumining_heart.d: A heart that lights itself: a heart mended every five seconds, no darkness takes her sight, and when she is badly hurt she is hardest to hurt further.
attribute.matex.trait.great_fire.desc: Antares, the Great Fire, is the Heart mansion's own star: fire cannot touch her, what she strikes burns, and under the night sky her blows carry the star's heat.
attribute.matex.effect.stealth: Hostiles lose sight of her unless she struck within 5s
screen.matex.girl_traits.locked: Her traits are hers by character and cannot be changed
